name: NDVI 条件下的平均地表温度 / NDVI-conditioned mean LST
when: 需要按 NDVI 阈值筛选像元并计算平均 LST，例如比较植被与非植被区域。Mean land surface temperature selected by an NDVI threshold.
validation: 用户授权暂时入库。仅原题一轮有/无 Skill 配对回放，两组均答对；尚无准确率提升或跨题迁移证据。
caveat: 参考建议，不是强制规则。确认目标为均值而非最大值或比例，并核对输入及实际工具语义。
content: Use calculate_mean_lst_by_ndvi to compute mean LST values for different NDVI threshold conditions when comparing temperature differences between vegetated and non-vegetated areas. This tool directly handles the conditional mean calculation by taking red_paths, nir_paths, lst_paths, ndvi_threshold, and mode parameters ('above' or 'below'), eliminating the need for intermediate threshold segmentation and separate mean calculations that may fail due to NaN values or format issues.
